# sigma_user_attribute_team_assignment (Resource)

Manages a Sigma user attribute assignment for one team.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sigma_user_attribute_team_assignment" "example" {
  user_attribute_id = "user-attribute-id"
  team_id            = "team-id"
  value              = "americas"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `team_id` (String) Team ID.
- `user_attribute_id` (String) User attribute ID.
- `value` (String) Assigned string value.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite assignment ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/usr/bin/env sh
terraform import sigma_user_attribute_team_assignment.example user-attribute-id/team-id
```
